title: Promoting Social Connectedness Through Food
discussion_signal: The OECD discussion presents growing, preparing, and sharing food as low-stigma ways to strengthen social connection, linking affordability, culture, public space, community activity, and belonging.
linked_research_question: How is food being used as social infrastructure linking affordability, culture, public space, and belonging?
limits: The post announces a report and does not measure outcomes for each activity
It does not establish whether food initiatives reach the most excluded people
Institutional framing may understate cost, labour, and access constraints
